item.title: ICC member states vote to remove chief prosecutor Karim Khan
item.description: The International Criminal Court voted to remove the global tribunal's chief prosecutor on Friday, nearly two years after sexual misconduct allegations against him first emerged, the court's oversight body announced.

item.title: Oil surges to $100 per barrel. And, Trump imposes a new round of tariffs
item.description: Oil surged to $100 per barrel after Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. And, President Trump overnight replaced expiring tariffs with a slew of new ones.

item.title: Indian activist Wangchuk ends 26-day hunger strike as 'Cockroach' protesters vow to press on
item.description: Indian activist Sonam Wangchuk ended a 26-day hunger strike on Friday that helped galvanize a youth movement that's become one of India's largest protests in recent years, but demonstrators vowed to continue until the education minister resigns.
